hyperparameters.method: D = C x factor^beta x pace^beta_pace; factor = shrunk EWMA of actual/expected allowed by the opponent to the position (k=10 games); beta=0.712, beta_pace=0.211 fitted on development.

hypothesis: Defences allow systematically different production to guards/forwards/centres than expected.
limitations: Opponent effects are real but small relative to minutes and role.

point.result: D vs C CRPS: validation -0.0093 (95% CI -0.0125 to -0.0060), holdout -0.0180 (95% CI -0.0217 to -0.0143); factor sd 0.029.
